scope: Independent source inspection of an uncommitted device-adaptation candidate; no Windows compilation, native PE execution, endpoint playback or audible-output measurement
existing_api_risk: NativeAudio.SetSource currently trusts LoadedSnapshot.Frames rather than validating its managed Samples.Length before exposing the pointer. Current production callers use SnapshotReader-validated objects; no demonstrated user-path trigger.
limits: Source and converted snapshots each bounded to 32M stereo frames; upsampled capacity can reject.
Very short downsampling can produce zero output; explicit error is retained.
Windows shared-mode effects/device state and actual endpoint output remain unmeasured.
Current Windows source-rate audition remains separate from future shared native CPR modes.
